title: Kalinago language
description: Arawakan language historically spoken in the Lesser Antilles
extract: The Kalinago language, also known as Island Carib and Igneri, was an Arawakan language historically spoken by the Kalinago of the Lesser Antilles in the Caribbean. Kalinago proper became extinct by about 1920 due to population decline and colonial period deportations resulting in language death, but an offshoot survives as Garifuna in Central America.
